∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), s.coordinates = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four s.generation s.status s.remaining s.reserved
∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.accepts before after = Bool.true → after.remaining + after.reserved ≤ before.remaining + before.reserved
∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.accepts before after = Bool.true → before.generation ≤ after.generation

∀ (g r h charge : ℤ), 0 ≤ g → 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ h → 0 ≤ charge → charge ≤ h → Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.accepts (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt { generation := g, status := 3, remaining := r, reserved := h }) (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.settle (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt { generation := g, status := 3, remaining := r, reserved := h }) charge) = Bool.true

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), 0 ≤ s.generation → 0 ≤ s.remaining → 0 ≤ s.reserved → s.status = 1 ∨ s.status = 2 ∨ s.status = 3 ∨ s.status = 4 → Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.accepts s (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt s) = Bool.true

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.witnessCaveat before.generation) { slots := [] } { slots := ("request/verb", 2) :: Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.slots (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt before) after } ≠ Bool.true

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.executionCaveat before.generation) { slots := [] } { slots := ("request/verb", 2) :: Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.slots (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt before) after } ≠ Bool.true

∀ (operation : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.Operation) (subject : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (nonce task : ℕ) (capability : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId) (expectedRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (before : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (publications : List Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Target) (observeCapability : Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId), (operation.command subject nonce task capability expectedRoot before publications observeCapability).targets.tail = publications

∀ (operation : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.Operation) (task : ℕ) (capability : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId) (expectedRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (before : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (observeCapability : Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId), (operation.target task capability expectedRoot before observeCapability).payload = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Payload.scalar (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.actions task before (operation.after before))

∀ (management : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old st : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.policy management) old st = Bool.true → st.get "request/verb" = Option.some 2 → st.get Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.refillSlot ≠ Option.some 1 → ∃ d, st.get "resource/pair/2/3/delta" = Option.some d ∧ d ≤ 0
∀ (task : ℕ) (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.readState task (s.store task) = Option.some s

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.refillAccepts before after = Bool.true → after.generation = before.generation ∧ after.status = before.status ∧ before.reserved = 0 ∧ after.reserved = 0 ∧ before.remaining < after.remaining ∧ (before.status = 0 ∨ before.status = 1 ∨ before.status = 2)

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (amount : ℤ), (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.Operation.refill amount).after s = { generation := s.generation, status := s.status, remaining := s.remaining + amount, reserved := s.reserved }

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (amount : ℤ), 0 ≤ s.generation → 0 ≤ s.remaining → s.reserved = 0 → s.status = 0 ∨ s.status = 1 ∨ s.status = 2 → 0 < amount → Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.refillAccepts s ((Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.Operation.refill amount).after s) = Bool.true
∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (amount : ℤ), (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.reserve s amount).remaining + (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.reserve s amount).reserved = s.remaining

∀ (g r h : ℤ), 0 ≤ g → 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ h → Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.accepts { generation := g, status := 4, remaining := r, reserved := h } (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.interrupt { generation := g, status := 4, remaining := r, reserved := h }) = Bool.true

∀ (task : ℕ) (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.project task (before.store task) (after.store task) = Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.slots before after

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.executionCaveat before.generation) { slots := [] } { slots := ("request/verb", 2) :: Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.slots (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.trip before) after } ≠ Bool.true

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.State) (generation : ℤ), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.executionCaveat generation) { slots := [] } { slots := ("request/verb", 2) :: Minidregg.Kernel.AgentGrain.slots before after } = Bool.true → before.generation = generation ∧ after.generation = generation
